new_series.title: The Celebrity Traitors
new_series.synopsis: Claudia Winkleman welcomes a brand new group of celebrities as they arrive at a beautiful castle in the Scottish Highlands to play the ultimate reality game of detection, back-stabbing and trust.

new_series.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
new_series.synopsis: Ed Gamble and guests unpack all the drama from episode 1 of the second series of The Celebrity Traitors.

new_series.title: Have I Got News for You
new_series.synopsis: Richard Ayoade hosts, with guest panellists broadcaster Gyles Brandreth and singer-songwriter Charlotte Church joining team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton as they delve into the news.

new_series.title: The Reluctant Vampire
new_series.synopsis: Being a vampire has never come naturally to Val, but as he is heir to the throne, all eyes are on him to live up to expectations. When his mum reveals a huge secret, all becomes clear.

new_series.title: Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over
new_series.synopsis: Stacey Dooley spends the weekend at Nevada’s oldest legal brothel and meets the people in charge. She questions if legal brothels can act as a solution to the dangers sex workers face.

new_series.title: Whatever Happened to Baby Jane Austen?
new_series.synopsis: Dawn French and Jennifer Saunders star as respected novelist Florence and movie star Selina, in a sparkling comedy series about two sisters at war, by Veep writer David Quantick.

new_series.title: Cooking with the Stars
new_series.synopsis: Emma Willis and Tom Allen return with the contest as 12 famous faces are each mentored by a chef to compete in culinary battles over 10 weeks. The first head-to-head showdown is between actress Caroline Quentin, Gladiators star Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Emmerdale actor Mark Charnock as they attempt to deliver classic family favourites. One contestant will go straight through to the next round, while the other two face each other in the dreaded cook off, after which one of them will leave the competition.
